purpose: User-requested continuation with original physical/FK guidance and stage-directory submission, retaining per-input checkpoints.
hardware: Apple M4 Max, 64 GB, managed Boltz 2.2.1 FP32/MPS
smoke: Two original sequence inputs in one structure request; intentionally interrupt after a native completion marker before controller commit. Recover without repeating completed folds, submit both saved structures to one affinity-head request, then replay all checkpoints without new inference.
held_constant: Original biotin chemistry/atom mapping, physical and FK guidance on, stage-specific pocket policy, 3 recycles, 200 diffusion steps, one output, seed0, empty MSA.
audit: One model per live worker, separate cached structure/affinity identities, per-input native output hashes and atomic markers; verify saved units after controller interruption and identical repeated-resume receipts. Only documented MPS SVD fallback allowed.
limits: Transport/resume integration test, not a new speed comparison or proof of final binder quality. Directory requests use a recorded request-level RNG stream; changing pending membership on resume can change future uncompleted samples. Completed predictions are never regenerated. No early termination, adaptive sampling, partial noising or production-default promotion. Long memory soak not tested.
